source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 5: The Past Continuous Tense

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế, options gần nhau.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp. Distractor gần đúng. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

starter.stem: At 8pm yesterday, she ___ for her IELTS exam.
starter.explanation_short: At 8pm yesterday = specific past moment → was studying.
starter.explanation_long: 'At 8pm yesterday'=thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ→Past Continuous: was+V-ing.
starter.feedback_wrong: At specific past moment → Past Continuous: was+V-ing
starter.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Past Continuous: at [time] yesterday, at this time last week.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: study(Simple Present), studied(Simple Past), is studying(Present Continuous)

starter.stem: I ___ my notes when the teacher ___ the class.
starter.explanation_short: was reviewing(dài, bị gián đoạn) + entered(ngắn, xen vào).
starter.explanation_long: Past Continuous(dài)=was reviewing. Simple Past(ngắn xen vào)=entered. Cấu trúc: was V-ing WHEN V2.
starter.feedback_wrong: was V-ing(dài) WHEN Simple Past(ngắn). Đây là cấu trúc cơ bản nhất!
starter.ielts_tip: WHEN: hành động ngắn Simple Past xen vào hành động dài Past Continuous.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: reviewed/entered(cả 2 Simple Past—mất bối cảnh)

starter.stem: While students ___ the exam, the fire alarm ___.
starter.explanation_short: while+were taking(nền dài) + rang(sự kiện ngắn).
starter.explanation_long: WHILE đi với Past Continuous(nền): were taking. Sự kiện ngắn xen vào=Simple Past: rang.
starter.feedback_wrong: WHILE+Past Continuous | sự kiện ngắn=Simple Past
starter.ielts_tip: WHILE→Past Continuous cho hành động nền. Sự kiện ngắn xen vào→Simple Past.
starter.distractor_note: plausible: were taking/was ringing(cả 2 Continuous—rang là sự kiện điểm, không dùng Continuous)

starter.stem: The students ___ when the principal walked in.
starter.ielts_tip: Chia be trong Past: I/he/she/it→was. you/we/they/plural→were.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: was talking(wrong number), is/are talking(Present)

starter.stem: At this time last year, I ___ for my university entrance exam.
starter.explanation_short: At this time last year=specific past moment → was preparing.
starter.explanation_long: 'At this time last year'=quá khứ tiếp diễn→was+preparing(-ing form).
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ At this time last year → was preparing
starter.feedback_wrong: At this time last year → Past Continuous: was+preparing
starter.ielts_tip: 'At this time last year/month' → Past Continuous. Khác với 'last year' (Simple Past).
starter.distractor_note: obvious: prepare(no was), was prepare(no -ing), prepared(Simple Past)

starter.stem: She ___ attention in class when the teacher explained the grammar rule.
starter.explanation_long: Phủ định Past Continuous: was/were+not+V-ing. 'Wasn't paying'=đúng.
starter.feedback_wrong: wasn't+V-ing. Không phải didn't+pay trong ngữ cảnh này.
starter.ielts_tip: Phủ định: Simple Past→didn't+V. Past Continuous→wasn't/weren't+V-ing.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: wasn't pay(no -ing), not was paying(word order)

starter.stem: When I ___ to school this morning, I ___ my old English teacher.
starter.explanation_short: was walking(bối cảnh dài) + met(sự kiện ngắn).
starter.explanation_long: was walking=hành động nền đang tiếp diễn. met=sự kiện bất ngờ xảy ra trong lúc đó.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ was walking(bối cảnh) + met(sự kiện bất ngờ)
starter.feedback_wrong: was walking(nền) WHEN met(sự kiện). Cấu trúc kể chuyện!
starter.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện: was V-ing(bối cảnh)...when Simple Past(sự kiện). Rất hay dùng trong Part 2.
starter.distractor_note: plausible: walked/met(cả 2 Simple Past—mất bối cảnh sinh động)

starter.stem: The class was ___ very hard when the power went out.
starter.explanation_long: study kết thúc bằng y→chỉ thêm -ing: studying(không studing hay studding).
starter.feedback_wrong: study→studying. Không nhân đôi y và không bỏ y.
starter.ielts_tip: CVC rule: run→running, sit→sitting. Kết thúc -y: study→studying, try→trying.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: studing(sai spelling), studied(Simple Past), study(V nguyên mẫu)

starter.stem: ___ you ___ English when the earthquake happened?
starter.explanation_long: Câu hỏi Past Continuous: Was/Were+S+V-ing? You→Were studying.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Câu hỏi Past Continuous: Were you studying?
starter.ielts_tip: Hỏi về past ongoing action: Were you V-ing? Was he/she V-ing?
starter.distractor_note: obvious: Did/study(Simple Past question), Was/studying(wrong be), Do/study(Present)

starter.stem: While I ___ for my exam, my phone ___ and it was my teacher calling.
starter.explanation_short: was studying(nền dài) + rang(sự kiện điểm ngắn).
starter.explanation_long: was studying=hành động đang diễn ra(dài). rang=sự kiện bất ngờ(ngắn). 'Ring'→rang(bất quy tắc).
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 was studying(nền) + rang(sự kiện). ring→rang bất quy tắc!
starter.feedback_wrong: was studying(dài)+rang(ngắn xen vào). ring→rang bất quy tắc.
starter.ielts_tip: ring→rang(bất quy tắc). Kết hợp Past Continuous+Simple Past = cấu trúc kể chuyện cơ bản.
starter.distractor_note: plausible: was studying/was ringing(rang là sự kiện điểm, không dùng Continuous)

build_up.stem: Speaking Part 2: Kể về một kỷ niệm học tập đáng nhớ — câu nào đặt bối cảnh tốt nhất?
options: It was a rainy afternoon. I studied in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I had studied in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library while the lights went out.
build_up.correct_answer: It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
build_up.explanation_short: was studying(bối cảnh nền) + went out(sự kiện bất ngờ khi+Simple Past).
build_up.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was studying=hành động nền đang tiếp diễn. Lớp 2: went out=sự kiện bất ngờ→Simple Past. Lớp 3: WHEN+Simple Past cho sự kiện bất ngờ(không WHILE).
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ was studying(nền)+WHEN+went out(bất ngờ). Part 2 bối cảnh hoàn hảo!
build_up.feedback_wrong: Past Continuous(nền)WHEN Simple Past(sự kiện). WHILE dùng cho 2 hành động song song.
build_up.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện Part 2: đặt bối cảnh bằng Past Continuous, sự kiện bằng Simple Past.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: while the lights went out(while+Simple Past thường dùng với Continuous)

build_up.stem: Câu nào mô tả đúng hai hành động song song trong quá khứ?
options: While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
While the teacher explained the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students took notes carefully.
While the teacher was explaining, students was taking notes carefully.
build_up.correct_answer: While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
build_up.explanation_short: WHILE+hai Past Continuous song song: was explaining + were taking.
build_up.explanation_long: WHILE diễn tả 2 hành động dài đang xảy ra đồng thời→cả 2 Past Continuous. 'Students was' sai(plural→were).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 WHILE+2 Past Continuous song song: was explaining+were taking
build_up.feedback_wrong: WHILE+hai hành động dài→cả 2 Past Continuous.
build_up.ielts_tip: WHILE→hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous. Khác với WHEN(1 ngắn+1 dài).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: explained+were taking(Simple Past+Continuous—mất tính song song)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'While I was preparing my IELTS application, my computer suddenly crashed and lost all my work.'
options: was preparing → prepared(Simple Past phù hợp hơn)
build_up.explanation_long: 'While I was preparing'=nền đúng. 'crashed'+'lost'=sự kiện ngắn bất ngờ→Simple Past đúng. Câu hoàn toàn đúng ngữ pháp.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🏆 Câu đúng hoàn toàn! while+was preparing+crashed+lost = chuẩn mực!
build_up.feedback_wrong: Câu đúng: while+Past Continuous(nền)+Simple Past(sự kiện).
build_up.ielts_tip: Bẫy quan trọng: không phải mọi động từ trong câu đều cần Continuous. Sự kiện ngắn→Simple Past.
build_up.distractor_note: bẫy: crashed/lost trông như cần Continuous vì 'while'—nhưng đây là sự kiện ngắn

build_up.stem: Câu nào ĐÚNG về trải nghiệm trong phòng thi IELTS?
options: While I was taking the exam, I was knowing all the answers but I was wanting more time.
While I was taking the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
While I took the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
While I was taking the exam, I was knowing all answers but wanted more time.
build_up.correct_answer: While I was taking the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
build_up.explanation_short: was taking(hành động đang diễn ra) + knew+wanted(stative→Simple Past).
build_up.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was taking=hành động đang diễn ra→Past Continuous đúng. Lớp 2: know+want=stative→không dùng -ing→knew, wanted.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ was taking(action) + knew+wanted(stative→Simple Past). Hai quy tắc trong 1 câu!
build_up.ielts_tip: Stative trong past context: know→knew, want→wanted, believe→believed(Simple Past, không Continuous).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: was knowing/was wanting nghe tự nhiên với người Việt

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The group of students was studying in the library while their teacher were preparing the next lesson.'
options: was → were | were → was(cả hai sai)
build_up.explanation_long: 'The group'=collective noun→British English singular→was studying đúng. 'their teacher'=singular→was preparing(không were). Lỗi nằm ở 'their teacher were'.
build_up.distractor_note: near-correct: 'was→were' bẫy mạnh vì group thường dùng plural

build_up.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào mô tả bối cảnh xã hội trong quá khứ chuẩn nhất?
options: In the 1990s, many students studied in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers struggled with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers struggled with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students studied in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
build_up.correct_answer: In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
build_up.explanation_short: WHILE+hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous.
build_up.explanation_long: WHILE diễn tả 2 hành động dài đồng thời→cả 2 Past Continuous: were studying+were struggling.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 WHILE+hai hành động dài đồng thời→cả 2 Past Continuous
build_up.feedback_wrong: WHILE+hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous.
build_up.ielts_tip: Task 2 mô tả bối cảnh quá khứ: 'In [decade], people were doing X while Y was happening'→Past Continuous.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: Simple Past nghe academic trong Task 2

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'My professor was explaining the concept when I suddenly was understanding it.'
options: was explaining → explained(Simple Past phù hợp hơn)
was explaining → explained | was understanding → understood
build_up.explanation_long: 'Was explaining'=đúng(hành động nền). 'Was understanding'=sai vì understand=stative→understood(Simple Past).
build_up.ielts_tip: Trong past context: understand→understood, know→knew, realize→realized(stative→Simple Past).
build_up.distractor_note: bẫy: was explaining trông cần sửa nhưng đúng. was understanding trông đúng nhưng sai

build_up.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Kể về lần đầu thi IELTS. Câu nào tự nhiên và đúng nhất?
options: When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates sat in silence.
When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
When I was arriving at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
When I was arriving at the test center, all candidates sat in silence.
build_up.correct_answer: When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
build_up.explanation_short: arrived(sự kiện ngắn) + were sitting(bối cảnh đang diễn ra).
build_up.explanation_long: arrived=sự kiện điểm→Simple Past. were sitting=hành động đang diễn ra khi tôi đến→Past Continuous.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ arrived(sự kiện)+were sitting(bối cảnh). Kể chuyện Part 2 chuẩn!
build_up.feedback_wrong: arrived(điểm)+were sitting(nền đang diễn ra). WHEN+Simple Past=sự kiện.
build_up.ielts_tip: WHEN+Simple Past(sự kiện) → bối cảnh đang diễn ra = Past Continuous. Tự nhiên và sinh động.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: sat+were sitting nghe đúng nhưng ngược chiều

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'While students were siting the exam, the teacher was walking around the room.'
options: was walking → walked(Simple Past phù hợp)
were siting → was sitting(singular phù hợp hơn)
build_up.explanation_short: sit kết thúc CVC→double t: sitting(không siting).
build_up.explanation_long: sit: CVC(consonant-vowel-consonant)→nhân đôi phụ âm cuối+ing: sitting. 'Siting'=sai spelling.
build_up.feedback_wrong: sit+ing=sitting(nhân đôi t). 'Siting' không tồn tại.
build_up.ielts_tip: CVC+ing: sit→sitting, run→running, get→getting, swim→swimming, begin→beginning.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: was walking→walked trông cần sửa

build_up.stem: Tìm câu KỂ CHUYỆN hoàn chỉnh nhất cho IELTS Speaking Part 2:
options: I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I walked to the school gate, and my heart beat fast.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate, and my heart was beating fast.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate when suddenly my heart beat faster.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I walked to the school gate while my heart was beating fast.
build_up.correct_answer: I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate when suddenly my heart beat faster.
build_up.explanation_short: was walking(bối cảnh) + beat faster(sự kiện bất ngờ với 'suddenly').
build_up.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was walking=bối cảnh đang diễn ra. Lớp 2: 'suddenly'+beat faster=sự kiện bất ngờ→Simple Past. Lớp 3: 'suddenly' là tín hiệu sự kiện ngắn→Simple Past.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🏆 was walking(bối cảnh)+suddenly+beat(sự kiện). Kể chuyện band 6.0+!
build_up.feedback_wrong: was walking(nền)+WHEN+suddenly+beat(sự kiện bất ngờ). Rất sinh động!
build_up.ielts_tip: Từ 'suddenly' → sự kiện ngắn bất ngờ → Simple Past(beat, not was beating). Rất hay trong Part 2.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B(2 Continuous) nghe đúng nhưng thiếu sự kiện bất ngờ

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While my classmates were celebrating their results, I was feeling devastated because I was believing I had prepared well.'
options: I was believing I had prepared well
challenge.correct_answer: I was believing I had prepared well
challenge.explanation_short: believe=stative→Simple Past: believed. was feeling có thể tranh luận.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'was believing'→believe=stative khi diễn tả niềm tin→'believed'. Lớp 2: 'was feeling devastated'→feel có thể dynamic(đang cảm thấy)→có thể giữ. Lớp 3: were celebrating+had prepared đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ believe=stative→believed. was feeling có thể chấp nhận(feel=dynamic emotion)!
challenge.feedback_wrong: believe=stative→believed. feel(emotion)=có thể Continuous trong một số ngữ cảnh.
challenge.ielts_tip: believe/think/know=stative→Simple Past. feel(emotion)=dynamic→có thể Continuous. Phân biệt tinh tế!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: was feeling trông sai nhưng có thể chấp nhận—was believing là lỗi rõ hơn.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While the examination board was reviewing all submitted portfolios, several candidates were discovered to have plagiarised, which caused a major scandal.'
challenge.explanation_short: Câu đúng hoàn toàn: was reviewing(nền)+were discovered(Passive Past, không Continuous).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'was reviewing'=Past Continuous cho hành động nền đúng. Lớp 2: 'were discovered'=Passive Simple Past(không Continuous) đúng vì đây là sự kiện phát hiện. Lớp 3: 'which caused'=Simple Past đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Câu đúng hoàn toàn! was reviewing(nền)+were discovered(Passive)+caused=chuẩn mực!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Câu đúng: Past Continuous(nền)+Passive Simple Past(sự kiện)+Simple Past(hệ quả).
challenge.ielts_tip: Passive Past: was/were+V3. Không nhầm với Past Continuous: was/were+V-ing.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: were discovered trông như Passive Continuous nhưng thực ra là Passive Simple Past

challenge.stem: Đoạn Part 2 nào thể hiện Grammatical Range CAO NHẤT?
options: I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I was desperately trying to solve them mentally.
I sat in the exam room when I suddenly realised I forgot my calculator. While other students worked on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students worked on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
I sat in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
challenge.correct_answer: I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I was desperately trying to solve them mentally.
challenge.explanation_short: was sitting(bối cảnh)+realised(sự kiện)+had forgotten(Perfect trước đó)+were working(song song)+was trying(song song).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was sitting(bối cảnh)WHEN realised(sự kiện)=đúng. Lớp 2: had forgotten=Past Perfect(xảy ra trước realised)=đúng. Lớp 3: WHILE were working+was trying=2 hành động song song=đúng. Ba thì khác nhau trong 2 câu=Grammatical Range band 6.5+.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Past Continuous+Simple Past+Past Perfect+WHILE+2 Continuous=Grammatical Range band 6.5+!
challenge.feedback_wrong: 4 thì khác nhau có chủ đích: was sitting, realised, had forgotten, were working, was trying.
challenge.ielts_tip: Part 2 band 6.5+: kết hợp 3-4 thì khác nhau có chủ đích trong cùng một đoạn.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C gần nhất—chỉ khác ở while clause dùng Simple Past thay Continuous.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The committee, together with several observers, were reviewing the examination papers while candidates was waiting anxiously outside.'
options: The committee, together with several observers, were reviewing
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'committee, together with observers'→'together with' không thay đổi số→committee=singular→was reviewing đúng(mặc dù nghe có vẻ sai). Lớp 2: candidates=plural→were waiting. Lỗi nằm ở 'candidates was'.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ candidates=plural→were waiting. 'Together with' không thay đổi chủ ngữ!
challenge.feedback_wrong: candidates=plural→were. 'Together with' không thay đổi chủ ngữ committee=singular.
challenge.ielts_tip: 'A, together with B' → chia theo A. 'A and B' → plural. Đây là bẫy cực phổ biến!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: were reviewing trông sai vì 'together with observers' khiến nghĩ plural

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While the professor was delivering his lecture, students in the front row were taking notes while those at the back was browsing social media.'
options: the professor was delivering his lecture
students in the front row were taking notes
those at the back was browsing social media
challenge.correct_answer: those at the back was browsing social media
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was delivering đúng(professor=singular). Lớp 2: were taking đúng(students=plural). Lớp 3: 'those at the back'→those=plural→were browsing(không was).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 those=plural→were browsing. was+plural=lỗi thường gặp trong câu dài!
challenge.feedback_wrong: those=plural→were browsing. Không phải was browsing.
challenge.ielts_tip: Trong câu dài: luôn track chủ ngữ của từng mệnh đề. 'Those'=plural→were.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: câu dài 3 mệnh đề—lỗi nằm ở mệnh đề cuối, dễ bỏ sót

challenge.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào mô tả bối cảnh lịch sử CHUẨN NHẤT về mặt học thuật?
options: In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously trying to address widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries rebuilt their education systems while simultaneously addressing widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously addressed widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously they were trying to address widespread poverty.
challenge.correct_answer: In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously trying to address widespread poverty.
challenge.explanation_short: were rebuilding(nền dài)+while+trying(parallel action=gerund trong cụm trạng từ).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: were rebuilding=hành động đang diễn ra trong giai đoạn dài→Past Continuous đúng. Lớp 2: 'while simultaneously trying'=cụm trạng từ song song→gerund đúng(không cần subject). Lớp 3: Option D thêm 'they were'→lặp chủ ngữ không cần thiết.
challenge.feedback_wrong: were rebuilding(giai đoạn dài)+while trying(parallel action)=academic Task 2 chuẩn.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2 academic: Past Continuous cho giai đoạn dài trong quá khứ. 'while+gerund'=không cần subject.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B(cả 2 Simple Past) academic nhưng thiếu bối cảnh diễn ra liên tục

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Researchers were observing that students who were preferring visual learning methods were performing significantly better than those who were relying solely on text.'
options: students who were preferring visual learning
those who were relying solely on text
challenge.explanation_short: observe(that)=stative reporting verb→Simple Past: observed that.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'observe that'=reporting verb cho quan sát/nhận thấy=stative-like→observed that. Lớp 2: 'were preferring'→prefer=stative→preferred. Lớp 3: were performing+were relying=dynamic actions→có thể Continuous. Lỗi [A] rõ nhất: observe that=stative.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ observe(that)=reporting stative→observed that. prefer=stative→preferred cũng sai!
challenge.ielts_tip: Reporting verbs như stative: observe(that)/note(that)/find(that) khi nêu kết quả→Simple Past.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: were preferring cũng sai(prefer=stative) nhưng observe that là lỗi đầu tiên

challenge.stem:
Câu Task 2 sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi về thì?
'[A]While educators was discussing curriculum reform, [B]students were experiencing increasing pressure, and [C]policymakers were not yet realising the full extent of the problem.'
options: Không có lỗi trong cả 3 mệnh đề
challenge.explanation_short: [A]educators=plural→were discussing. [B]were experiencing=đúng. [C]were not yet realising=có thể chấp nhận.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A]'educators was'→educators=plural→were discussing. Lớp 2: [B]were experiencing=đúng(dynamic action). Lớp 3: [C]'were not yet realising'→realise có thể dynamic(đang dần nhận ra)→Past Continuous có thể chấp nhận trong ngữ cảnh này.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🎯 1 lỗi: educators=plural→were discussing. realising trong ngữ cảnh này có thể chấp nhận!
challenge.feedback_wrong: educators=plural→were(không was). realising(đang dần nhận ra)=dynamic→có thể Continuous.
challenge.ielts_tip: realise=thường stative nhưng 'gradually realising'=dynamic(đang dần nhận ra)→có thể Continuous. Context matters!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B(2 lỗi) bẫy vì realising trông sai

challenge.stem: Câu Task 2 nào kết hợp ĐÚNG Past Continuous và Simple Past để phân tích xã hội?
options: In the 1980s, the economy was struggling, many workers lost their jobs, and the government was introducing new policies to address the crisis.
In the 1980s, the economy struggled, many workers were losing their jobs, and the government introduced new policies to address the crisis.
In the 1980s, while the economy was struggling and many workers were losing their jobs, the government introduced sweeping new policies to address the crisis.
In the 1980s, the economy was struggling, many workers were losing their jobs, and the government was introducing new policies to address the crisis.
challenge.correct_answer: In the 1980s, while the economy was struggling and many workers were losing their jobs, the government introduced sweeping new policies to address the crisis.
challenge.explanation_short: was struggling+were losing(bối cảnh nền)→WHILE+introduced(hành động đáp lại=điểm).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: was struggling+were losing=hành động nền đang diễn ra. Lớp 2: introduced=hành động điểm đáp lại bối cảnh→Simple Past. Lớp 3: Cấu trúc WHILE+Past Continuous[bối cảnh], Simple Past[hành động]=Grammatical Range cao nhất.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 WHILE+was struggling+were losing(bối cảnh)→introduced(hành động đáp lại). Band 6.5+!
challenge.feedback_wrong: WHILE+Past Continuous(bối cảnh)+Simple Past(hành động đáp lại)=cấu trúc Task 2 tinh tế nhất.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2 analysis: WHILE+Past Continuous(context)+Simple Past(government response)=structure most graders reward.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D(3 Continuous)đúng ngữ pháp nhưng thiếu contrast giữa bối cảnh và hành động

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'While [A]professors was delivering their lectures via Zoom, students [B]were experiencing technical difficulties and [C]was feeling increasingly frustrated, which [D]were causing significant disruption to the learning process.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A]professors=plural→were. [B]were experiencing=đúng. [C]was feeling→students=plural→were. [D]which were causing→which=singular clause→was causing.
challenge.explanation_long: [A]professors=plural→were delivering. [B]were experiencing=đúng(students plural+dynamic). [C]'was feeling'→students=plural→were feeling. [D]'which were causing'→which thay cho toàn mệnh đề(singular)→was causing. Ba lỗi.
challenge.ielts_tip: Review: (1)plural subjects→were, (2)which thay clause=singular→was, (3)stative trong past context.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D(4 lỗi) bẫy mạnh—[B] trông sai nhưng đúng.

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Starter
ui.description: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp.

items.stem: At 8pm yesterday, she ___ for her IELTS exam.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ At 8pm yesterday → was studying
items.feedback_wrong: At specific past moment → Past Continuous: was+V-ing
items.explanation_short: At 8pm yesterday = specific past moment → was studying.
items.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Past Continuous: at [time] yesterday, at this time last week.

items.stem: I ___ my notes when the teacher ___ the class.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 was reviewing(nền) + entered(xen vào)
items.feedback_wrong: was V-ing(dài) WHEN Simple Past(ngắn). Đây là cấu trúc cơ bản nhất!
items.explanation_short: was reviewing(dài, bị gián đoạn) + entered(ngắn, xen vào).
items.ielts_tip: WHEN: hành động ngắn Simple Past xen vào hành động dài Past Continuous.

items.stem: While students ___ the exam, the fire alarm ___.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ while+were taking + rang(sự kiện)
items.feedback_wrong: WHILE+Past Continuous | sự kiện ngắn=Simple Past
items.explanation_short: while+were taking(nền dài) + rang(sự kiện ngắn).
items.ielts_tip: WHILE→Past Continuous cho hành động nền. Sự kiện ngắn xen vào→Simple Past.

items.stem: The students ___ when the principal walked in.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 students=plural→were talking
items.feedback_wrong: students=plural→were(không was)+talking
items.explanation_short: students=plural→were talking.
items.ielts_tip: Chia be trong Past: I/he/she/it→was. you/we/they/plural→were.

items.stem: At this time last year, I ___ for my university entrance exam.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ At this time last year → was preparing
items.feedback_wrong: At this time last year → Past Continuous: was+preparing
items.explanation_short: At this time last year=specific past moment → was preparing.
items.ielts_tip: 'At this time last year/month' → Past Continuous. Khác với 'last year' (Simple Past).

items.stem: She ___ attention in class when the teacher explained the grammar rule.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Phủ định Past Continuous: wasn't+paying
items.feedback_wrong: wasn't+V-ing. Không phải didn't+pay trong ngữ cảnh này.
items.explanation_short: Phủ định Past Continuous: wasn't+V-ing.
items.ielts_tip: Phủ định: Simple Past→didn't+V. Past Continuous→wasn't/weren't+V-ing.

items.stem: When I ___ to school this morning, I ___ my old English teacher.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ was walking(bối cảnh) + met(sự kiện bất ngờ)
items.feedback_wrong: was walking(nền) WHEN met(sự kiện). Cấu trúc kể chuyện!
items.explanation_short: was walking(bối cảnh dài) + met(sự kiện ngắn).
items.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện: was V-ing(bối cảnh)...when Simple Past(sự kiện). Rất hay dùng trong Part 2.

items.stem: The class was ___ very hard when the power went out.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 study→studying(thêm -ing)
items.feedback_wrong: study→studying. Không nhân đôi y và không bỏ y.
items.explanation_short: study→studying(không double-y, chỉ thêm -ing).
items.ielts_tip: CVC rule: run→running, sit→sitting. Kết thúc -y: study→studying, try→trying.

items.stem: ___ you ___ English when the earthquake happened?
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Câu hỏi Past Continuous: Were you studying?
items.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi Past Continuous: Was/Were+S+V-ing?
items.explanation_short: Câu hỏi Past Continuous: Were+S+V-ing?
items.ielts_tip: Hỏi về past ongoing action: Were you V-ing? Was he/she V-ing?

items.stem: While I ___ for my exam, my phone ___ and it was my teacher calling.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 was studying(nền) + rang(sự kiện). ring→rang bất quy tắc!
items.feedback_wrong: was studying(dài)+rang(ngắn xen vào). ring→rang bất quy tắc.
items.explanation_short: was studying(nền dài) + rang(sự kiện điểm ngắn).
items.ielts_tip: ring→rang(bất quy tắc). Kết hợp Past Continuous+Simple Past = cấu trúc kể chuyện cơ bản.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Build Up
ui.description: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế, options gần nhau.

items.stem: Speaking Part 2: Kể về một kỷ niệm học tập đáng nhớ — câu nào đặt bối cảnh tốt nhất?
options: It was a rainy afternoon. I studied in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I had studied in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library while the lights went out.
items.correct_answer: It was a rainy afternoon. I was studying in the library when suddenly the lights went out.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ was studying(nền)+WHEN+went out(bất ngờ). Part 2 bối cảnh hoàn hảo!
items.feedback_wrong: Past Continuous(nền)WHEN Simple Past(sự kiện). WHILE dùng cho 2 hành động song song.
items.explanation_short: was studying(bối cảnh nền) + went out(sự kiện bất ngờ khi+Simple Past).
items.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện Part 2: đặt bối cảnh bằng Past Continuous, sự kiện bằng Simple Past.

items.stem: Câu nào mô tả đúng hai hành động song song trong quá khứ?
options: While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
While the teacher explained the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students took notes carefully.
While the teacher was explaining, students was taking notes carefully.
items.correct_answer: While the teacher was explaining the grammar rule, students were taking notes carefully.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 WHILE+2 Past Continuous song song: was explaining+were taking
items.feedback_wrong: WHILE+hai hành động dài→cả 2 Past Continuous.
items.explanation_short: WHILE+hai Past Continuous song song: was explaining + were taking.
items.ielts_tip: WHILE→hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous. Khác với WHEN(1 ngắn+1 dài).

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'While I was preparing my IELTS application, my computer suddenly crashed and lost all my work.'
options: was preparing → prepared(Simple Past phù hợp hơn)
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Câu đúng hoàn toàn! while+was preparing+crashed+lost = chuẩn mực!
items.feedback_wrong: Câu đúng: while+Past Continuous(nền)+Simple Past(sự kiện).
items.explanation_short: While+was preparing(nền) + crashed+lost(sự kiện ngắn)=đúng.
items.ielts_tip: Bẫy quan trọng: không phải mọi động từ trong câu đều cần Continuous. Sự kiện ngắn→Simple Past.

items.stem: Câu nào ĐÚNG về trải nghiệm trong phòng thi IELTS?
options: While I was taking the exam, I was knowing all the answers but I was wanting more time.
While I was taking the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
While I took the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
While I was taking the exam, I was knowing all answers but wanted more time.
items.correct_answer: While I was taking the exam, I knew all the answers but I wanted more time.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ was taking(action) + knew+wanted(stative→Simple Past). Hai quy tắc trong 1 câu!
items.feedback_wrong: was taking(action). know+want=stative→knew, wanted(Simple Past).
items.explanation_short: was taking(hành động đang diễn ra) + knew+wanted(stative→Simple Past).
items.ielts_tip: Stative trong past context: know→knew, want→wanted, believe→believed(Simple Past, không Continuous).

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The group of students was studying in the library while their teacher were preparing the next lesson.'
options: was → were | were → was(cả hai sai)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 teacher=singular→was preparing. 'group'=collective→was studying đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: teacher=singular→was(không were). group collective→was đúng.
items.explanation_short: 'teacher'=singular→was preparing. 'group' British English→was đúng.
items.ielts_tip: group/team/class: British English→plural(were). Nhưng teacher=individual→was.

items.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào mô tả bối cảnh xã hội trong quá khứ chuẩn nhất?
options: In the 1990s, many students studied in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers struggled with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers struggled with limited resources.
In the 1990s, many students studied in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
items.correct_answer: In the 1990s, many students were studying in overcrowded classrooms while their teachers were struggling with limited resources.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 WHILE+hai hành động dài đồng thời→cả 2 Past Continuous
items.feedback_wrong: WHILE+hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous.
items.explanation_short: WHILE+hai hành động song song→cả 2 Past Continuous.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2 mô tả bối cảnh quá khứ: 'In [decade], people were doing X while Y was happening'→Past Continuous.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'My professor was explaining the concept when I suddenly was understanding it.'
options: was explaining → explained(Simple Past phù hợp hơn)
was explaining → explained | was understanding → understood
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ understand=stative→understood. was explaining=đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: understand=stative→không Continuous→understood.
items.explanation_short: understand=stative→không dùng -ing trong past. understand→understood.
items.ielts_tip: Trong past context: understand→understood, know→knew, realize→realized(stative→Simple Past).

items.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Kể về lần đầu thi IELTS. Câu nào tự nhiên và đúng nhất?
options: When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates sat in silence.
When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
When I was arriving at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
When I was arriving at the test center, all candidates sat in silence.
items.correct_answer: When I arrived at the test center, all the candidates were sitting in silence.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ arrived(sự kiện)+were sitting(bối cảnh). Kể chuyện Part 2 chuẩn!
items.feedback_wrong: arrived(điểm)+were sitting(nền đang diễn ra). WHEN+Simple Past=sự kiện.
items.explanation_short: arrived(sự kiện ngắn) + were sitting(bối cảnh đang diễn ra).
items.ielts_tip: WHEN+Simple Past(sự kiện) → bối cảnh đang diễn ra = Past Continuous. Tự nhiên và sinh động.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'While students were siting the exam, the teacher was walking around the room.'
options: was walking → walked(Simple Past phù hợp)
were siting → was sitting(singular phù hợp hơn)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 sit→sitting(double t). CVC rule!
items.feedback_wrong: sit+ing=sitting(nhân đôi t). 'Siting' không tồn tại.
items.explanation_short: sit kết thúc CVC→double t: sitting(không siting).
items.ielts_tip: CVC+ing: sit→sitting, run→running, get→getting, swim→swimming, begin→beginning.

items.stem: Tìm câu KỂ CHUYỆN hoàn chỉnh nhất cho IELTS Speaking Part 2:
options: I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I walked to the school gate, and my heart beat fast.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate, and my heart was beating fast.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate when suddenly my heart beat faster.
I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I walked to the school gate while my heart was beating fast.
items.correct_answer: I remember the day I got my IELTS results. I was walking to the school gate when suddenly my heart beat faster.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 was walking(bối cảnh)+suddenly+beat(sự kiện). Kể chuyện band 6.0+!
items.feedback_wrong: was walking(nền)+WHEN+suddenly+beat(sự kiện bất ngờ). Rất sinh động!
items.explanation_short: was walking(bối cảnh) + beat faster(sự kiện bất ngờ với 'suddenly').
items.ielts_tip: Từ 'suddenly' → sự kiện ngắn bất ngờ → Simple Past(beat, not was beating). Rất hay trong Part 2.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp. Distractor gần đúng. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While my classmates were celebrating their results, I was feeling devastated because I was believing I had prepared well.'
options: I was believing I had prepared well
items.correct_answer: I was believing I had prepared well
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ believe=stative→believed. was feeling có thể chấp nhận(feel=dynamic emotion)!
items.feedback_wrong: believe=stative→believed. feel(emotion)=có thể Continuous trong một số ngữ cảnh.
items.explanation_short: believe=stative→Simple Past: believed. was feeling có thể tranh luận.
items.ielts_tip: believe/think/know=stative→Simple Past. feel(emotion)=dynamic→có thể Continuous. Phân biệt tinh tế!

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While the examination board was reviewing all submitted portfolios, several candidates were discovered to have plagiarised, which caused a major scandal.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Câu đúng hoàn toàn! was reviewing(nền)+were discovered(Passive)+caused=chuẩn mực!
items.feedback_wrong: Câu đúng: Past Continuous(nền)+Passive Simple Past(sự kiện)+Simple Past(hệ quả).
items.explanation_short: Câu đúng hoàn toàn: was reviewing(nền)+were discovered(Passive Past, không Continuous).
items.ielts_tip: Passive Past: was/were+V3. Không nhầm với Past Continuous: was/were+V-ing.

items.stem: Đoạn Part 2 nào thể hiện Grammatical Range CAO NHẤT?
options: I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I was desperately trying to solve them mentally.
I sat in the exam room when I suddenly realised I forgot my calculator. While other students worked on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students worked on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
I sat in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I desperately tried to solve them mentally.
items.correct_answer: I was sitting in the exam room when I suddenly realised I had forgotten my calculator. While other students were working on their math questions, I was desperately trying to solve them mentally.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Past Continuous+Simple Past+Past Perfect+WHILE+2 Continuous=Grammatical Range band 6.5+!
items.feedback_wrong: 4 thì khác nhau có chủ đích: was sitting, realised, had forgotten, were working, was trying.
items.explanation_short: was sitting(bối cảnh)+realised(sự kiện)+had forgotten(Perfect trước đó)+were working(song song)+was trying(song song).
items.ielts_tip: Part 2 band 6.5+: kết hợp 3-4 thì khác nhau có chủ đích trong cùng một đoạn.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The committee, together with several observers, were reviewing the examination papers while candidates was waiting anxiously outside.'
options: The committee, together with several observers, were reviewing
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ candidates=plural→were waiting. 'Together with' không thay đổi chủ ngữ!
items.feedback_wrong: candidates=plural→were. 'Together with' không thay đổi chủ ngữ committee=singular.
items.explanation_short: candidates=plural→were waiting(không was waiting).
items.ielts_tip: 'A, together with B' → chia theo A. 'A and B' → plural. Đây là bẫy cực phổ biến!

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While the professor was delivering his lecture, students in the front row were taking notes while those at the back was browsing social media.'
options: the professor was delivering his lecture
students in the front row were taking notes
those at the back was browsing social media
items.correct_answer: those at the back was browsing social media
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 those=plural→were browsing. was+plural=lỗi thường gặp trong câu dài!
items.feedback_wrong: those=plural→were browsing. Không phải was browsing.
items.explanation_short: those=plural→were browsing(không was browsing).
items.ielts_tip: Trong câu dài: luôn track chủ ngữ của từng mệnh đề. 'Those'=plural→were.

items.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào mô tả bối cảnh lịch sử CHUẨN NHẤT về mặt học thuật?
options: In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously trying to address widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries rebuilt their education systems while simultaneously addressing widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously addressed widespread poverty.
In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously they were trying to address widespread poverty.
items.correct_answer: In the decades following World War II, many countries were rebuilding their education systems while simultaneously trying to address widespread poverty.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 were rebuilding(nền)+while+trying(parallel gerund). Academic nhất!
items.feedback_wrong: were rebuilding(giai đoạn dài)+while trying(parallel action)=academic Task 2 chuẩn.
items.explanation_short: were rebuilding(nền dài)+while+trying(parallel action=gerund trong cụm trạng từ).
items.ielts_tip: Task 2 academic: Past Continuous cho giai đoạn dài trong quá khứ. 'while+gerund'=không cần subject.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Researchers were observing that students who were preferring visual learning methods were performing significantly better than those who were relying solely on text.'
options: students who were preferring visual learning
those who were relying solely on text
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ observe(that)=reporting stative→observed that. prefer=stative→preferred cũng sai!
items.feedback_wrong: observe(that)=stative→observed. prefer=stative→preferred. performing+relying=dynamic=OK.
items.explanation_short: observe(that)=stative reporting verb→Simple Past: observed that.
items.ielts_tip: Reporting verbs như stative: observe(that)/note(that)/find(that) khi nêu kết quả→Simple Past.

items.stem:
Câu Task 2 sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi về thì?
'[A]While educators was discussing curriculum reform, [B]students were experiencing increasing pressure, and [C]policymakers were not yet realising the full extent of the problem.'
options: Không có lỗi trong cả 3 mệnh đề
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 1 lỗi: educators=plural→were discussing. realising trong ngữ cảnh này có thể chấp nhận!
items.feedback_wrong: educators=plural→were(không was). realising(đang dần nhận ra)=dynamic→có thể Continuous.
items.explanation_short: [A]educators=plural→were discussing. [B]were experiencing=đúng. [C]were not yet realising=có thể chấp nhận.
items.ielts_tip: realise=thường stative nhưng 'gradually realising'=dynamic(đang dần nhận ra)→có thể Continuous. Context matters!

items.stem: Câu Task 2 nào kết hợp ĐÚNG Past Continuous và Simple Past để phân tích xã hội?

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'While [A]professors was delivering their lectures via Zoom, students [B]were experiencing technical difficulties and [C]was feeling increasingly frustrated, which [D]were causing significant disruption to the learning process.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! 3 lỗi: [A]were|[C]were feeling|[D]was causing. [B]đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: [A]professors→were.[C]students→were feeling.[D]which(clause)→was causing.[B]were experiencing=đúng.
items.explanation_short: [A]professors=plural→were. [B]were experiencing=đúng. [C]was feeling→students=plural→were. [D]which were causing→which=singular clause→was causing.
items.ielts_tip: Review: (1)plural subjects→were, (2)which thay clause=singular→was, (3)stative trong past context.
